description:
- Added useful stream details beneath the existing server names in the player.
- Shows supported quality, audio languages, and subtitles when detected.
- Added live status labels for playing, paused, loading, buffering, and failed sources.
- Distinguishes untried servers, previously tried servers, and prepared backups.
- Server details refresh while the selector is open, including during automatic failover.
- Failed servers remain available to retry.
